title: Cycle evaluation determines a unique morphism
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], T and J integer cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and n an integer. If e,e' are morphisms H^n(Hom(T,J)) -> Hom(H^(-n)(T),H^0(J)), each satisfying the cycle formula of [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions], then e=e'. No concentration, K-injectivity or finite-free hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: sites-cohomology.tex, section-hom-complexes; cohomology.tex, section-internal-hom (08DH), complex evaluation; duality.tex, lemma-regular-ideal-ext (0BQY), zero-differential Hom calculation.

proof.text: Apply homologyEvaluation_unique_of_cycle_of_local_lifts to the two given cycle formulas and supply its lifting hypothesis with homologyEvaluation_local_cycle_lift. Both intermediate statements are proved; the first uses epimorphism cancellation and the second uses the differential projection formula and preservation of cycle kernels.
